lines.en: : Oh hey, you’re still alive. Yumi is growing.
: We all are. That is why Akira likes us.
: She’s not wrong.
: She rarely ever is.
: Seeing as our “meeting” has concluded and that we have the rest of the night to ourselves before our classmates start showing up, we need to figure out what to do now. Any suggestions?
: I...could throw together another impromptu sex competition?
: No.
: No.
: Sure-
: Oh. Really? Just me?
: Any other ideas?
: Not a single one of you? Seriously?
: Why am I the one being looked to for answers? I’m still the newcomer to this group. Let Akira decide our plans for the rest of the night if anything.
: He’s just going to choose the same thing as you.
: Then he and I can have a 1v1 sex competition with each other while Nodoka judges and the two of you can go be boring with Yumi or something.
: I’m not trying to make anyone here uncomfortable. So the clearest solution to this dilemma is for me to have sex with each one of you individually.
: I mean, you might as well just rank us at that point.
: We do have options apart from sexual ones, you know. There are movies, board games, the ten other pizzas we set aside for Maya.
: Those are for later and I would prefer to eat them in private.
: Oh, I see. You prefer to eat in private but are more than willing to engage in a sex competition with the rest of us.
: Is there something about that you find difficult to understand, Makoto?
: Nope. That’s pretty much par for the course with this class nowadays.
: What if there’s something both sexual and not sexual we can do together to make everyone happy?
: Like?
: There’s that new spa they just opened up. Down the hall from the sauna. We could all hang out there and unwind before vacation formally starts tomorrow?
: And what? Turn Sensei into our private massage therapist in lieu of the actual staff members here?
: It’s fine. I can take one for the team.
: Not even. I’m pretty sure the rules say you’re not allowed to completely undress in there.
: Okay, so turns out I had it backwards and we’re all naked now. Whoops.
: There is a zero percent chance that this is going to remain non-sexual. I’m calling it now.
: Now, I wouldn’t say that, Makoto. I placed Akira here in a very similar situation during the last Dorm Wars and he handled it quite flawlessly. Isn’t that right, Maya?
: At least initially. It wasn’t until later when he got to take all of those frustrations out on me. I sure hope that doesn’t happen again tonight.
: I can’t remember. I needed to purge that night from my mind to rationalize the fact that I wasn’t chosen.
: Oh, so that’s where you all disappeared to. Why wasn’t I invited?
: Apologies, but you didn’t fit the theme. You’ve already grown too much.
: Perhaps I can pass you an invitation if I can acquire enough wedding dresses for a future competition I have in mind, though.
: Sounds good to me! Any chance I get to see my future husband nervously stand there with an erection is one that I am obligated to take as his kinky future bride.
: It appears that we have mistaken Hell itself for a spa. This is just as dangerous as the Dorm Wars hotel room.
: I’d say it’s more dangerous as we’re all as vulnerable as can be now. Yourself included, Akira.
: If only Yumi were here with us as well. I imagine the four of us could hold her down quite easily and confirm once and for all just how much she likes our teacher here.
: I care a little less about how much she likes him and more about how much he likes us. And by “us” I mean me. You know what must be done, Sensei.
: I don’t think I’ve ever known anything less than I have in this moment. I’m surprised my brain can even function when I assume all of the blood in my body is currently inside of my penis.
: I don’t see what the big deal is. You’ve seen all of us naked plenty of times before.
: Yeah, but never at once. This changes everything.
: Does it? Perhaps I simply don’t understand. I wonder if there is anything that can be done to enlighten me?
: Don’t fall for her trap, Sensei. We both know I’m the one you want to spend some extra time with in here. There’s no need for someone like me to try and trick you, is there?
: Uhh...
: I’m not going to bother trying to convince you at all.

: Instead, I will attempt to break you by reminding you that your childhood friend is probably sitting on some couch thinking about you right now while you debate which naked teenager to have your way with.
: Wow. Thanks, Maya.
: You’ll choose me if you’re sad. This is what must be done, unfortunately.
: Well, well. It appears a competition has simply fallen into my lap this time. This is far easier than planning it.
: Don’t call it a competition. It’ll supercharge Makoto and either we’ll wind up losing or we’ll have to listen to her cry about not winning for the rest of the night.
: Look at me, you disgusting predator. Look at what I have become because of you. This is all your fault. My future could have been so bright. So promising.
: Okay, Maya. I think you might be going a little overboard here.
: All’s fair in love and sex. Isn’t that right, Akira? With so many forbidden fruits all in one place, we might need to make you a whole basket.
: I don’t have enough penis for all of you.
: Now, that’s just blatantly false. We could all probably fit a hand around it if we angle ourselves correctly.
: Why do you look away? Feast your eyes on what stands before you. There’s nothing to be afraid of here.
: Unless, of course, the resort staff is still present despite us renting the entire facility out and could catch you committing heinous crimes at any moment.
: They call it jailbait for a reason though, don’t they?
: Just look at Maya. How slender...how breakable she is. Don’t you feel compelled to just split that cute little creature in two?
: Look at me any longer and I might have to start touching myself.
: Oh, come on! We don’t want to break him. We just want to tease him until he cums on his own from looking at us.
: No thanks. I want him inside of me before he even has the chance to spill everything on the floor. And he wants to be inside of me too. Don’t you, Akira?
: I want to be inside all of you but, again, not enough penis.
: That’s why you must choose wisely. You can seize us tonight, Akira. I won’t punish you the same way twice.
: It doesn’t have to be just one either. You can mix and match. Take three and leave one out. Whatever you like. We have a whole night ahead of us, don’t we?
: Just you...and four eager little girls. Each with their own strengths and weaknesses. Ready to kill time until the sun rises and it becomes much harder to reserve moments of intimacy with us.
: Nodoka does make a good point. Miss Imai, Miss Watabe, and Rika are all going to be here tomorrow. Dodging all three of them will inevitably be harder than...well, whatever this is.
: Poor Rika. I don’t think I’ve ever heard anyone call her Ms. Rokuhara.

: Akira...if you want to make the best use of your time, you should start now. I don’t really mind the other girls getting a turn as well so long as we go in order of height. Shortest to tallest, of course.
: How about worst vision to best vision? That’s the only category I can think of where I’m beating all three of you.
: Guys, please.

: If Sensei’s going to be having sex with us in order, he should be doing it in order of breedability. And no one’s more ready for that than me. Right, Sensei? You’ve got yourself a whole baby factory down here.
: I’ll savor last every last drop the way it’s meant to be savored.
: Maya doesn’t even want kids. Do you really want to cum inside of some girl who just wants to spit it all out? Or do you want to put a baby inside of someone? Huh?
: The only problem is that once Sensei is inside of me, he won’t ever want to take it out. So I feel kind of bad for subjecting the rest of you to-
: You can breed me too! Fuck it! We don’t even know if it’s possible with the way time works here, so I’ll be the test dummy!
: And that should be more alluring than Ayane asking you to do the same since she’s always wanted that and I made you wear a condom the first like hundred times we did it.
: You got Sensei to wear a condom? How dare you.
: Condoms are for cowards. Why would anyone want a fleshy latex-covered tube inside of them when you could just use the pull-out method and lie there drenched in semen for a while?
: I’m just as breedable as Ayane! And if for some reason you think I’m not, you can have both Nodoka and me at the same time! I owe her a favor anyway.
: Oh? Are we forming alliances now?
: I knew my constant poking and prodding would get you one day.
: How would you like to do this, Makoto? Shall I gently tickle your swollen bud, nibbling on your ear as he thrusts in and out of you? Or would you perhaps like to use your tongue on my-

: Make no mistake, Nodoka. Just because I have agreed to share Sensei with you does not mean I am attracted to you. And if you so much as think of touching my “swollen bud,” I will have you eliminated.
: Oh dear. I suppose my passing is well-overdue then as I’ve been dreaming of doing such things since the moment we met.
: Okay, Maya. I know you’re opposed, but it seems like we’re going to have to team up as well if we want to win this.
: I’m not opposed at all. I knew this would happen eventually.
: But at the shrine the other day-
: Yeah, I just say things sometimes. I’m more than willing to have a threesome with you. If anything, I’m surprised you want to on account of the whole “not liking girls” thing.
: It’s easy when I think about how much Sensei will enjoy it. And if I’m sharing him with someone I care about, like you, I don’t really mind another girl being there.
: Just sorry in advance if I don’t easily let him out of me. I can be kind of clingy during sex. You might have to bite me or something.
: I can do that. In fact, I want to do that. That sounds hot.

: Oh, right. I, like...vaguely remember the old Maya telling me once that she’s had a threesome with pretty much all of us. So I guess it makes sense that you would need to be at least kind of into it.
: All of you? That’s so many. When did the old me become such a slut?
: To be fair, you did have like thousands or millions of years or something. Which I imagine is also how much time you’d need in order to rationalize a threesome with Noriko.
: No. I imagine that threesome will be entirely irrational when it happens. Which I’ve always kind of figured it would on account of the whole “rivals” thing. I’m just not looking forward to it.
: I don’t think I’ve ever heard you call her your “rival” before. It’s normally just “bitch” or “whore.” I want to be your rival too. You guys aren’t the only ones in love with Sensei.
: I can only have one. And I’m not about to become rivals with someone who just gave me permission to bite her a second ago.
: Rock, paper, scissors to see who starts with the penis inside of them?
: Let’s at least figure out who Akira is going to choose before we-
: Oh, there’s no fucking way.
: Did he...did he leave? Did he just walk away from all four of us naked and fighting over him?
: This is why I never fucking take my eye off of him. He’s nothing but a disappointment when it matters most.
: Huh.
: I suppose we’ll all just need to have sex without him then.
: Uhh...
: The fuck you doin’ over here for?
: Thought you were going to the fuckin’ spa thing with everyone else?
: I was.
: Okay...
: And?
: Executive dysfunction.
: Ah.
: Okay.
: Don’t they make some kinda “male-enhancement” pill for that?
You have received a picture message from Nodoka Nagasawa!
